prompt: Goal: safer hospital shift handover during a ten-minute understaffed overlap, with a legally usable record. Selected direction: the handover assembles continuously from events during the shift; outgoing and incoming nurses correct and accept unresolved duties instead of composing a report at the end. Constraints: no extra meeting, dashboard, or transcription step; silent errors and skimming are the main concern.

Goal: make the closing of a ninety-year family bakery survivable without turning staff grief into a public event. Selected direction: hold the public farewell six weeks early while the shop is still trading, then leave the actual final day unannounced and private. Constraints: no merchandise, memory wall, press event, or surprise crowd on the final day.

Goal: a card-prototypeable negotiation mechanic without dialogue trees, hidden dice, or a persuasion stat. Selected direction: each side places the future action it will permanently give up onto a shared table; agreement exists only where the remaining action sets overlap. Players must understand consequences before committing.

Goal: help teenagers form durable local friendships through a library programme with two staff members and no app, matching, points, or supervised social event. Selected direction: small groups inherit responsibility for maintaining and modifying one useful physical thing in the library, with membership transferred through the maintenance log rather than staff assignment.

Goal: a pocket toy for a child travelling alone, interesting over many journeys, with no screen, electricity, collectibles, fictional companion, or adult facilitation. Selected direction: the toy records only changes in the route—turns, stops, reversals, waits—and those changes physically alter what moves are available on the next journey.

Goal: a story that remains inside one ordinary office building for a year and generates escalating choices without haunting, secret labs, trapped occupants, surveillance AI, time loops, or an unreliable reveal. Selected direction: every team must relinquish permanent access to one shared space whenever it misses a public commitment, so the building's usable geography becomes a record of promises.

Goal: a twenty-minute adult classroom activity that teaches why a precise estimate can mislead, with no quiz, lecture, coin flip, forecasting game, or computer. Selected direction: learners must physically allocate one shared strip of limited space to represent ranges for competing real claims; narrowing one claim visibly takes explanatory room from another.

Goal: reduce loneliness among older adults living alone, using three existing neighbourhood shops, collecting no personal data, and avoiding matching apps, calls, volunteer visits, classes, or companion robots. Selected direction: the shops coordinate incomplete everyday errands that require a later customer to finish one small step, creating repeated low-stakes recognition without enrolment.
목표: 아파트 주민의 실제 전력 사용을 한 달 동안 줄인다. 선택한 방향: 개인별 절약을 독려하지 않고 동별로 매일 사용할 수 있는 공용 전력 예산을 먼저 정하며, 남은 예산이 있을 때만 공동 설비의 운영 시간이 열린다. 제약: 죄책감, 순위, 경품, 대시보드, 인증, 아이 교육을 쓰지 않는다.
목표: 두 층 사이 계단참에서만 성립하고 한 달 안에 설치 가능한 경험을 만든다. 선택한 방향: 위층에서 내려오는 사람이 남긴 실제 무게만큼 아래층에서 올라오는 사람이 잠시 들고 갈 수 있는 물건의 선택지가 바뀐다. 제약: 유령, 리미널 미학, 비밀 문, 시간 조작, 거울 착시는 제외한다.

Goal: help a small research team select risky experiments without adding a scoring dashboard or weekly meeting. Selected direction: every proposed experiment must name the result that would make a different proposal preferable; proposals are reviewed through these cross-trigger conditions rather than independent scores.

Goal: make a neighbourhood planning hearing expose real trade-offs without extending the meeting beyond ninety minutes. Selected direction: participants may advocate for a benefit only after choosing which currently protected benefit their proposal is allowed to reduce. Constraints: no app, token vote, breakout workshop, or expert panel.
